provides: For a fundamental coordinate shear with p=e_i and a nonzero transverse integer Fourier sector xi, beta=2pi|xi|>0. The selfadjoint compression C=P*cos(2pi*y) has a constant transverse polarization represented by multiplication bycos, which has no L2 eigenvectors. The in-plane divergence-free component is psi inH1 with velocity norm integral(|psi_prime|^2+beta^2|psi|^2). A real eigenvalue lambda in[-1,1] obeys weakly -(q*psi_prime)_prime+beta^2*q*psi=0,q=cos(2pi*y)-lambda. Set g=q*psi_prime; then g_prime=beta^2*q*psi inL2, hence g inH1 and continuous. At every simple or double zero ofq, g must vanish, otherwise psi_prime=g/q would not beL2. Integrating against conjugatepsi on each sign interval gives zero boundary term and integral q*(|psi_prime|^2+beta^2|psi|^2)=0, forcingpsi=0. Outside[-1,1], contraction or the same definite form excludes eigenvalues. Thus this exact one-sector compression has NO L2 velocity eigenvectors. The actual calibrated transport multiplies C by2pi*(a_prime.xi), so this consequence applies only to NONRESONANT sectors with a_prime.xi!=0. It supplies no quantitative decay, absolute continuity, polynomial mixing time, full monodromy, uniform calibrated composition or new fixed-spatial-actuator controller. The existing2B5 growing-frequency robust theorem remains complete under its accepted premises; the NEW fixed-actuator-family endpoint remains OPEN.

The in-plane divfree velocity is represented by psi inH1, with norm integral(|psi'|²+beta²|psi|²). A C-eigenvector with eigenvalue lambda in[-1,1] satisfies weakly

On each interval between zeros, integrate against conjugatepsi; boundaryterm conjugatepsi*g vanishes, giving integral q(|psi'|²+beta²|psi|²)=0. The sign ofq on that interval forcespsi=0. Forlambda outside[-1,1], contraction or the same definiteform excludeseigenvalues. Thus this exact one-sector compression has NO L2velocityeigenvectors.
